content:
mike: Heads up — we detected a cluster of flaky GPUs in eu-west-1 during the last maintenance window. 6 cards showing repeated Xid/ECC spikes and two with serial mismatch on the depot intake. Need RMA + swap routing.

tara: Can you paste the ECC/Xid counters and which nodes?

mike: Nodes: gw-eu-03, gw-eu-07, gw-eu-11. Short log + nvidia-smi from gw-eu-07 below.

mike: ```
> nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,UTILIZATION
GPU 0
    ECC Errors
        Volatile:  124
        Aggregate: 124
    Utilization
        Gpu: 98 %
        Memory: 85 %

Kernel log excerpt:
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 79, PID=3456 
[ 12346.012345] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 63, PID=3460
```

tara: Ok that's noisy. 63/79 both point to driver/kernel/firmware issues but hardware looks suspicious given ECC counts. Did we try a soft reset / reboot?

mike: Rebooted twice, evicted workloads, did memtest (quick) — errors persist. We flagged those GPU IDs for drain.

oncall-bot: ALERT: gw-eu-07 gpu0 drained automatically by oncall policy (slo-impact: medium). Ticket rma-queued created.

rma-bot: RMA ticket created: NV-203412. Assigned vendor: vendor-nv. ETA pending vendor confirmation.

jen: Warehouse — do we have 6 compatible spares in eu-west depot or do we crossdock from central?

warehouse: We have 4 spares in eu-west spare-pool-2 (SKU: RTX-Std-32G) and 3 in central-eu (AZE warehouse). We can do a crossdock swap but need serial photos + manifest. Lead time: 36-48h for same-day courier booking, 24h if we use our expedited contract (cost uplift).

sam: Cost center? If we pull expedited it should charge infra-costs-eu (project: inference-run). Confirm before booking.

mike: Prefer expedite for 2 customer-critical nodes (gw-eu-03, gw-eu-07). Others can wait normal crossdock. We'll mark priority for 2 cards.

vendor-nv: Hi team — we saw NV-203412. For RMA we need: serial photo (front), SKU label, and fill our manifest. Also confirm whether serial parity shows printed vs intake scan mismatch; that can change disposition. Expected depot swap 3-5 business days after we receive parts + photos.

mike: Serial list (from intake CSV):
- GPU_SERIAL_A: SERN-AX1-9023  (gw-eu-03)
- GPU_SERIAL_B: SERN-BY2-3341  (gw-eu-07)  <-- intake scanned as BY2-3341 but sticker looks different
- GPU_SERIAL_C: SERN-CZ3-7788  (gw-eu-11)
- GPU_SERIAL_D: SERN-DQ4-1192  (gw-eu-12)
- GPU_SERIAL_E: SERN-EF5-5566  (gw-eu-15)
- GPU_SERIAL_F: SERN-FG6-0011  (gw-eu-16)

tara: For the two priority nodes, include device photos + chassis slot + backplate sticker. Use this template for the manifest:
```
manifest_id: RED-190876
priority: high/normal
items:
  - serial: SERN-BY2-3341
    node: gw-eu-07
    issue: high ECC + Xid 79
    photo_urls: [https://img.redwood/internal/190876/1.jpg]
```

mike: Uploading photos now. Also found a parity mismatch on BY2-3341: intake barcode = BY2-3341, sticker = BY2-3347. Took 3 pics and a short video of the slot.

warehouse: Received photos. Preparing outbound manifest. How should we handle return of suspect cards? Direct return to vendor depot or to our quarantine bin (eu-west quarantine)?

vendor-nv: If sticker parity mismatch, we request direct vendor depot return to help reconcile RMA faster. If customer wants to log serial dispute we can open a reconciliation ticket but that lengthens TAT.

sam: Let's direct-return priority 2 to vendor depot. Non-priority we can send to eu-west quarantine for further inspection. Chargeback: sam confirm project will accept expedited cost for 2 swaps.

sam: Confirmed. Charge to infra-costs-eu.

mike: Draft outbound manifest (short):
```
manifest: RED-190876-A
from: eu-west-depot-2
to: vendor-nv-depot-1 (direct-return for priority items)
items:
  - serial: SERN-BY2-3341
    rma_ticket: NV-203412
    priority: high
  - serial: SERN-AX1-9023
    rma_ticket: NV-203412
    priority: normal
  - serial: SERN-CZ3-7788
    rma_ticket: NV-203413
    priority: normal
```

jen: Courier booked? Provide AWB and customs (if cross-border). Also check EU internal routing (no export docs needed).

warehouse: Courier booked for priority box (DHL exp). AWB: DHL123456789EU. ETA pickup 2026-03-20 08:00 local. Non-priority will go in regular pallet on 2026-03-22.

vendor-nv: Acknowledged pickup. We'll update NV-203412 when parts received. Please ensure photos attached to ticket and include depot manifest.

mike: Quick note — one of the cards shows intermittent PCIe flapping before Xid 79. I'll file a follow-up with logs in case vendor wants firmware trace.

mike: dmesg snippet for gw-eu-03: 
```
[ 54321.001] pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: AER: Corrected error received: ID 0000:03:00
[ 54321.002] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 31, PID=4123
[ 54321.010] NVRM: GPU reset completed
```

oncall-bot: NOTE: Two nodes (gw-eu-03, gw-eu-07) marked critical, routing fallback applied, autoscaler draining non-critical jobs.

tara: After vendor confirmation we'll schedule replacements in console and bump canary weight to route traffic off these hosts until swaps complete.

mike: Thanks all — I'll follow up in NV tickets. For tracking, I'll update RED-190876 internal doc with AWB and vendor updates. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

jen: :thumbsup: got it.

warehouse: Packed priority box, scanned outbound — sent manifest to vendor and attached to NV-203412.

vendor-nv: Received manifest and photos. Awaiting inbound. We will process RMA on receipt and send depot swap confirmation. Expected disposition: Replace or refurb depending on failure trace.

mike: Closing loop — update thread when vendor confirms receipt and replacement ETA.
